_comment: REFERENCE ONLY -- not loaded by load_country_config / load_all_country_configs. Copy to conf/countries/{CC}.json (e.g. SG.json) to register a new country.
_how_it_works: Every country config is merged ON TOP of conf/base.json (the master config). A country file only needs the keys it OVERRIDES; everything else (EnrichDate, standardization, match rules, invalid_values, source/golden_source specs, target_schema, ...) is inherited from base.json. An empty object {} is a valid country file that inherits all base defaults (see MY.json).
_filter_condition: Optional. Defaults to "CountryCode = '<CC>'" derived from the file name. Override only for non-standard slicing.
_source_override_example: Override the input for one country (e.g. read Parquet files instead of the shared Delta views). format is one of delta | csv | parquet; use 'table' for delta or 'path' for csv/parquet, plus optional Spark reader 'options'.
_other_overrides: Any base.json key may be overridden here, e.g. EnrichDate, golden_id_floor (only ever raise), allow_source_golden_group_merge, standardization, exact_match_rules, fuzzy_match_rules, default_fuzzy_blocking, target_schema.
